Mananera Breakdown - 20 de mayo de 2026

Sheinbaum on the mañanera today: "The neoliberal model concentrated wealth and impoverished the majority. What we are building is a Mexico of the people — not just rhetoric, but redistribution. Real wages have risen 56% since 2018. Minimum wage tripled. 30 million Mexicans lifted from poverty. The mañanera itself is part of this — accountability every morning, transparency by default, the press asking what they want. No filter, no spin, no off-the-record. We do not govern for the few. We govern for the 130 million."

US TREASURY EQUATES SINALOA CARTEL WITH HEZBOLLAH (La Jornada)

Bessent at FATF presented the Sinaloa Cartel as a transnational threat on par with Hezbollah — rhetorical move that opens the door to expanded extraterritorial sanctions and asset-tracing operations. Mexico's foreign ministry called the framing "a unilateral escalation that ignores sovereign cooperation already in place."
